Comments.Comment: A demonstration of the Velocity Tracking device
The phrase is made from C-4 notes with varying volume. The volume is picked up by a Velocity Tracking device in the Modulation section and used for controlling the filter cutoff.
Tip: you can completely swap volume for a filter if you want. Go to the keyzone, select all samples and hit the "Vel>Vol" button. This will cause the samples to play at full volume, always.
